# Hang Yu 余航

Source: https://hangyu8123.github.io/

Ph.D. Candidate · Tufts University · HRI & Robot Learning

I am a Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at Tufts University, advised by Dr. Elaine Short in the Assistive Agent and Behavior Learning lab. My work focus on Human-Robot Interaction, Robot Learning, VLAs, and Agentic Robotics. Most of my datasets are open-sourced and were collected in public spaces with real-world, non-expert users. Right now I am a research intern at ABB Robotics, working on building new VLA models for bimanual manipulation and exploring agentic robotics for industrial robotics.

[Email](mailto:hyu08@tufts.edu)   [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=j0qxKQIAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao)   [GitHub](https://github.com/HangYu8123)   [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hang-yu-0343b2273/)   [CV (PDF)](https://hangyu8123.github.io/assets/cv.pdf)

## About

I am a Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at Tufts University, advised by Dr. Elaine Short in the  [Assistive Agent and Behavior Learning lab (AABL)](https://aabl.cs.tufts.edu/) . I work on improving robot learning from multi-modular human teaching, including human feedback, human demonstrations, and outputs from VLM/LLM. Most of my data is open-sourced and collected from public spaces with real-world non-expert users.

Actively open to research collaborations in HRI, RLHF for robots, and human data collection methodology.

### Research Interests

Topics

Interactive RL • Learning from Human Feedback • Learning from Demonstrations • Human modeling for robot learning • Evaluation & datasets for HRI

Keywords

HRI, RLHF/RLAIF, IntRL, Preference learning, Human factors

![Human teaching a robot using kinesthetic teaching demonstrations for imitation learning](https://hangyu8123.github.io/assets/img/interests-1.png)

![Interface for robot learning from rich human feedback showing scalar and directional inputs](https://hangyu8123.github.io/assets/img/interests-2.jpg)
